text_block_list.text:
A music event where the Umamusume charm the crowd with songs and dances, and the rankings are decided by audience votes.
As for how confident Fusaichi Pandora is—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Duh, winning is obvious♪
choice_data_list: You're awfully confident.
You're awfully confident.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's me, right? I'm a genius, aren't I?
Besides, look!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Spin, spin, ta-daah♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—See? Don't I look totally,
insanely invincible in this outfit?♪
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're right!
Yeah, you're right!

text_block_list.text: Fusaichi Pandora proudly showed off her racing outfit. I recall her unique 'dedication' woven into those clothes—

Design proposals prepared according to
Fusaichi Pandora's requests.
However, she kept asking for retakes over and over...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hmm... That's not it at all~!
choice_data_list: I think this more or less meets your request, though?
I believe this meets your request, though?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That's true, but that's not what I mean!
Isn't this an outfit made to "captivate" in a race?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Then it's gotta stand out way more!
Like 'Genius♡ Center☆ BAM!'♪
choice_data_list: …S-so, you mean…?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, you don't get it?!
Is it 'cause I'm just too much of a genius...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, oh, I know!
Why don't I just design it?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, can I draw the design?
I wanna try it, and I think I kinda like doing stuff like that!
"It's true that some Umamusume design their own racewear. Leaving it to her might be just what we need to break through this rut."
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll leave it to you
Got it, I'll leave it to you.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Okay! So far, I think I've really got the hang of it~

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, bringing it all together into shape might be tricky?
Sooo... off I go to expand my imagination♡

Though she boldly declared she would 'draw' it with full confidence,
she visited an apparel shop to sort out
her 'stroke of genius.'

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I'm totally in love with these sleeves~♡
That fluttery feel? It looks super great when moving!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That one-piece is cute too♡
Excuuuse me, could you show me that one~?♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Every single one was so cute~~♪
It totally hyped me up♡
choice_data_list: How is it? Figured out a design yet?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~, just a little more.
I still need more inspiration.
choice_data_list: Want to check out some other apparel shops, then?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Never mind about that.
If we're going next, then... yeah. Over there!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Pandora-chan unstoppable mo~de☆
Zoom! Zoo-oo-oom!

Fusaichi Pandora enters a nearby arcade
and starts playing a shooting game.
choice_data_list: Wait, doesn't that have nothing to do with the design?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"No, I do! And it's super important!
So pleaaase wait just a bit ♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I wonnnn~~!! New high score!!
Yeaaaaay♪ Peace, peace☆

Fusaichi Pandora is having a total blast.
Before she knows it, the spectators captivated by her play
break into applause.
choice_data_list: (But still, it has nothing to do with the design, yeah?)
(But still, it has nothing to do with the design, right?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Then, Trainer.
Buy me a sketchbook on the way home♪
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Huh?" as in, the DE-SIGN-☆
The vision's all set, so I wanna start drawing right away♪
choice_data_list: Did you really freeze up playing a game?
Did you really freeze up playing a game?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Totes! I won, right? Hyped, right?
When I thought 'what looks fire on me right now,'
ideas just totally came flooding in!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"People ask me this every now and then~.
'You're super confident, but don't you ever
think about what happens if you lose?'"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Never even crossed my mind!
I mean, it's me we're talking about, right?
Thinking about stuff like that would just be pointless, like.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Then wouldn't it be much more lovely
to think about "how to present" my victory?☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Pandora-chan, who we cheered sooooo much for,
is gonna put on a Winning Live
in a suuuuper cute outfit♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"‘Nothing suits Pandora better than winning!’
I want people to think that!
That's the kind of racing dress I want to wear!"

She doesn't even fathom the idea of losing.
Faced with a conviction too straightforward to be called arrogance, I couldn't help but let out a wry smile.
choice_data_list: (I guess this side of her is just so like her)

text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Fusaichi Pandora finished her racing outfit design
just as she promised. Even to an amateur's eye,
her artistic flair was...
choice_data_list: It's so good...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Right~? And also, also!
There's something I wanna show ya~♪

What she handed over
was a sparkling badge
adorned with her initials.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
The sign that looks coolest when you win☆
And that one's for you!
choice_data_list: Huh? Does this match yours?
Huh? Is this matching with yours?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
When I win, the one standing by my side
is gotta be you, right?
After all, we're besties chasing victory together ♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I want you to carry it with me too!
This 'legend' that I'm going to create!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
You have it on you today too, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, of course.
Yeah, of course.

text_block_list.text:
I take out a badge with the same design
as the accessory on her outfit,
and call out to her.
choice_data_list: Go out there and make genius Umamusume history again today!
That outfit, and you today, are both looking amazing!♪
That outfit, and you today, are both looking amazing!♪

text_block_list.text:
I take out a badge with the same design
as the accessory on her outfit,
and call out to her.
choice_data_list: Go out there and make genius Umamusume history again today!
That outfit, and you today, are both looking amazing!♪
That outfit, and you today, are both looking amazing!♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Okaaay!
Leave it all to Pandora-chan~♪"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoooo!!
It's everyone's favorite, Fusaichi Pandora! ♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Let's sing today! Let's dance!
Let's get suuuuuper hyped together♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha♪ Hilarious~~!
Like, of course that's totally obvious~~☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, that really pumped me up!
Alrighty, I'm off then~~!

Fusaichi Pandora dashed off innocently.
Watching her back, I renewed my vow
to turn her into a top-tier Umamusume.
